systems.system: NINACAD-Adresse: national digital addressing with six-digit codes, a geolocation application and a territorial database, said to offer local governments a free means to reference businesses, economic activities and public services
systems.owner: not named; presented to the government under the Prime Minister on 2025-03-10
systems.tiers: about 1.5 million places and plots in the ten communes of Bamako District, neighbouring communes of Kati cercle and the town of Ségou; rollout under way in Koulikoro and Sikasso

note: A national addressing system presented on 2025-03-10 and offered to the collectivités territoriales as a tool; the document does not say any local government uses it at its office or how such an office is connected.
